title: MHERO Opens New Flagship Showroom
excerpt: Our newest flagship showroom brings the full MHERO experience to life with an immersive digital configurator and dedicated test-drive circuit.
body: MHERO has unveiled its newest flagship showroom, designed to give visitors an immersive first-hand look at the full model range.
The space features an interactive digital configurator, a dedicated after-sales lounge, and an on-site test-drive circuit for both Model 1 and Model 2.
Visitors can now book private viewing appointments or walk in during extended weekend hours.

title: MHERO I Wins International Design Award
excerpt: MHERO I has been recognized for its exterior design language at this year's International Automotive Design Awards.
body: MHERO I has received top honors at this year's International Automotive Design Awards, recognized for its distinctive exterior silhouette and signature lighting architecture.
The award panel highlighted the model's balance of rugged capability with refined surfacing, calling it 'a new benchmark for full-size SUV design.'
This marks MHERO's second major design recognition since launch.

title: MHERO Expands Regional Service Network
excerpt: Five new authorized service centers are now open, extending genuine parts and warranty support across the region.
body: MHERO has expanded its after-sales network with five new authorized service centers, ensuring owners have convenient access to genuine parts, scheduled maintenance, and warranty support.
Each new center is staffed by factory-trained technicians and equipped with the latest diagnostic technology.
The expansion is part of MHERO's broader commitment to a best-in-class ownership experience.
